head: 7a2c8b9
summary: No shell regression between 87a5f4c and 7a2c8b9. 07_shell.js is unchanged, and every pixel change is lighting or seat material. q03 is pixel-identical. q07 changes only 0.003 % of pixels (one thin line at x 410-420, y 115-119). In q12 the changes (2.35 %) all lie in the pane (clouds), and the lining boxes are identical. The reveal (x 0-120) sits at 103/107/112 and the surround at 101/105/110 in both base and head. q16 changes 5.74 %, all in the seats (econ sheen); the sidewall, bins and carpet are unchanged. The q14 PY upper-wall change is small and moves toward the photos: the top band (x 300-420, y 95-110) went from 212/219/229 (L220, B-R +17) to 207/215/226 (L216, B-R +19). The piers between the windows are unchanged (214/220/236, L223, B-R +22), as are the lower wall (190/197/209, B-R +19) and the tub (171/179/191). py_37301 and py_37303 still show a cooler, darker wall: piers 158/170/192 and 149/160/182 (B-R +33/+34, L163-173), lower wall 187/194/209 and 173/182/199. So the render is still about 50 L brighter and somewhat less blue on the piers. That is an exposure difference (lighting), not a shell regression, and the head change goes in the right direction. Speck/crack scan (a pixel more than 40 L off its 5x5 median, new in head vs base): q03 0, q07 1, q12 1, q14 19. All 19 q14 pixels are threshold flips on existing ceiling/bin edge lines (base 36-40, head 41-43), with no new feature. q16 has 456, all on seat fabric. The q12 joint box (x 95-145, y 150-470) has 0 rows above median+25/+15/+10 in head and 0 at DPR 2 (box doubled, median L104). The groove row-min median is L68 at both DPRs, the same as base. Score held at 8.6; the carried low items keep the shell below 9.
